_comment: Known-stale KOV coverage reports whose pipeline_version is not a git object in this repository (#704). These reports are frozen corpus written from commits that were later squashed or rewritten; they are not rewritten by hand. run_all_integration.py --check-pipeline-versions exempts an entry only while the report still carries exactly this SHA. The list may only shrink: regenerate a report from a pushed commit and delete its entry. Adding an entry is a review decision, and tests/test_run_all_integration.py pins the set.
